entities.name: Vickers Type 264 Valentia
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The Vickers Valentia was a British biplane bomber transport aircraft built by Vickers for the Royal Air Force. The majority built were conversions of the earlier Vickers Victoria, itself derived from the Vickers Virginia.
